exact_statement: For all integers a>=1 and even m>=4, the one-shared-bit Boolean family F defined in REPORT.md has n=1+am coordinates, a connected GF(2) ANF interaction graph at the root, and I(F)=a[(m-1)/2+m*delta]+[1-(-2delta)^a]/2, delta=2^-m. On the actual selector-first stopping tree, the sum of 2I(D_v), even after every disjoint independent factor is removed optimally at every node, is T_factor=a*m*delta+delta*a(a-1)[3(m-2)/4+(4m-2)delta]. At every selected descendant B_v/Inf_v>=(m-1)/2. For any fixed finite K>=0 choosing m with (m-1)/2>K makes all selected nodes bad while T_factor/I tends to infinity as a grows. This rejects only the specified selector-first rule plus factor-removal repair. Revealing the shared bit z first instead gives B_z<=1<=8 Inf_z/3, hence zero K=4 internal bad-node bill, and retains explicit terminal references with costs <=4I(z=0) and <=2I(z=1). The fixed normalized root reference Q(A,R)=[Q0(R)+Q1(R)]/4 has complete CE=am+2-[(1+delta^a)/2]log2(1+4^a)<=8I(F)/3, including every root/branch/terminal/empty-sector cost. Universal adaptive C019 and full FEI remain open.

exact_statement: For every r>=1 and Boolean signs f_j(z,y_j)=g_{j,z}(y_j) sharing exactly one uniform physical bit z with mutually disjoint private blocks, set F=product_j f_j. In bits, let P_jb be each branch squared spectrum, R_j=(P_j0+P_j1)/2, R=(product_j P_j0+product_j P_j1)/2, B_j=H(S_z^j|S_yj^j), B_*=H(S_z^F|S_y^F), M_j=H(R_j)-average_b H(g_jb), M_*=H(R)-average_b sum_j H(g_jb), and TC=KL(R||product_j R_j). Then H(F)-sum_j H(f_j)=B_*-sum_j B_j-TC, M_*=sum_j M_j-TC, 0<=TC<=sum_j M_j, and H(F)<=sum_j H(f_j)+1. For any normalized complete module references Q_j with finite cross-entropy, let q_j(T)=sum_A Q_j(A,T), tau_j=Q_j/q_j, and k_j=E_Rj KL(nu_j||tau_j), with actual selector conditional laws nu_j. The normalized reference Q_*(A,Tvec)=nu_*(A|Tvec) product_j q_j(T_j), using any fixed conditional on zero true rows, satisfies CE_*=sum_j CE_j+B_*-sum_j B_j-sum_j k_j and CE_*-H(F)=TC+sum_j KL(R_j||q_j). If d_j=Inf_z(f_j), then d_*=Inf_z(F)=[1-product_j(1-2d_j)]/2, I(F)=sum_j average_b I(g_jb)+d_*, and sum_j I(f_j)-I(F)=sum_j d_j-d_*=2 E floor(N_flip/2)>=0. These are exact interfaces, not an influence bound for TC or a universal FEI proof.
